xBRIEFInfo.author: overdeck/0.0.0
xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4363: GPT-6 Sol and Luna fail with 400 on ChatGPT login below Codex 0.155, and Overdeck's version floor is 0.153.4

plan.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna fail with 400 on ChatGPT login below Codex 0.155, and Overdeck's version floor is 0.153.4
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: OpenAI's backend rejects gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna with HTTP 400 for ChatGPT-sign-in Codex clients below 0.155.x (0.156.1 is the first catalog-bearing release). Overdeck's only Codex gates are 0.144.0 (app-server) and 0.153.4 (native attach), so a host on 0.153.4-0.156.0 passes every Overdeck check, launches a Sol or Luna agent, and the agent dies on its first turn. pan doctor reports that Codex CLI as OK.
narratives.Proposal: Add a per-model Codex client-version floor table (gpt-6-sol and gpt-6-luna -> 0.156.1) beside MINIMUM_NATIVE_ENDPOINT_CODEX_VERSION, plus an async never-throwing, never-caching version reader and a resolveCodexPolicyContext helper. canUseHarness gains an optional sync fourth argument { codexCliVersion } and refuses the codex harness under subscription auth when the installed version is below the model's floor, naming the model, installed version, required version and the upgrade command `npm install -g @openai/codex`. resolveHarness (the async chokepoint every spawn path passes before writing agent state) and pan start's explicit --harness path read the version and pass it. pan doctor gains a Codex model floor row per floored model (WARN below floor). CLIProxy 7.3.16 was verified during planning to serve both models, so it only gets a comment and a docs line. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4363.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing pan install to install or upgrade the Codex CLI
- A client-version floor for the ohmypi openai-codex route, the ACP route, or remote (Fly) agents
- Changing providers.ts openai tierModels or model-capability-class.ts (that is PAN-4364)
- Fixing the reference install's CLIProxy oauth-model-alias config that hides the upstream gpt-6-sol id
- Bumping the CLIProxy pin (CLIPROXY_RELEASE_VERSION stays v7.3.16)
- Setting clientVersion in the app-server initialize request (the backend ignores it)
- Gating model pickers, tier validation, or the settings harness-policy endpoint on the installed Codex version
- Substituting another model or harness when the floor is not met
- Caching the Codex version across launches
- Refactoring doctor.ts checkCodex/readCodexVersion or other existing canUseHarness callers

autoDecisions.summary: The refusal and doctor fix name `npm install -g @openai/codex`, not `pan install`.
autoDecisions.rationale: pan install never installs or upgrades the Codex CLI: the only Codex install instruction is the copyable hint in src/lib/system-prerequisites.ts:183-192, whose header says Overdeck never runs system package installs itself. Naming pan install would send operators to a command that does not fix the 400. The string becomes one exported constant CODEX_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND that the prerequisites entry also uses.

autoDecisions.summary: The floor applies only when authMode === 'subscription'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The 400 is specific to ChatGPT-account clients; API-key users have no floor and must not be refused. getProviderAuthMode returns 'subscription' for a ChatGPT sign-in and never undefined for OpenAI.

autoDecisions.summary: An unreadable Codex version fails open at the policy and shows a WARN in doctor.
autoDecisions.rationale: Failing closed on a flaky --version probe would block every GPT-6 launch; the app-server's own assertSupportedVersion still fails loudly on an unparseable version.

autoDecisions.summary: The version is read fresh on every launch (no cache).
autoDecisions.rationale: The dashboard is long-lived; an operator who upgrades Codex must not stay refused until a restart, and codex --version is cheap.

autoDecisions.summary: pan doctor emits WARN (not FAIL) rows, one per floored model, and no rows when Codex is absent.
autoDecisions.rationale: Overdeck has no 'enabled model' setting, Sol and Luna are documented opt-in, and doctor exits 1 on any error row; the launch-time refusal is the hard stop. checkCodex already warns when Codex is missing.

autoDecisions.summary: canUseHarness stays sync and pure; host facts arrive through an optional fourth argument.
autoDecisions.rationale: canUseHarness is called synchronously by pickers, tier validation and the settings route. Only launch paths (resolveHarness, pan start's explicit flag) read the version, and every launch reaches resolveHarness before any agent state write (spawn.ts:680 before :715).

autoDecisions.summary: CLIProxy needs no pin change; record the verified version in a comment and the docs.
autoDecisions.rationale: On 2026-09-29 CLIProxy 7.3.16 returned 'ok' for gpt-6-luna directly and for gpt-6-sol through its claude-opus-5 alias under ChatGPT sign-in. The 'unknown provider for model gpt-6-sol' result for the bare id comes from the operator's oauth-model-alias config hiding upstream ids, not a version gate.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate on the Codex binary version, not Overdeck's clientInfo version.
autoDecisions.rationale: A planning probe ran codex app-server 0.158.0 with clientInfo overdeck/0.0.0 (what Overdeck sends) and completed a gpt-6-luna turn, so the backend reads the binary's version.

items.title: Add the Codex per-model floor table, install-command constant, version reader, and policy-context helper

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/lib/codex/app-server-manager.ts, under MINIMUM_NATIVE_ENDPOINT_CODEX_VERSION, export CODEX_MODEL_MINIMUM_VERSIONS = { 'gpt-6-sol': '0.156.1', 'gpt-6-luna': '0.156.1' }, CODEX_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND = 'npm install -g @openai/codex', codexModelMinimumVersion(model) using Object.hasOwn, parseCodexCliVersion(raw) (extracted from assertSupportedVersion without changing its behavior), and async readCodexCliVersion(binary = 'codex') that uses the existing promisified execFile with VERSION_TIMEOUT_MS, returns undefined on any failure, and never caches. Create src/lib/codex/policy-context.ts exporting interface HarnessPolicyContext { codexCliVersion?: string }, interface CodexPolicyContextDeps, and resolveCodexPolicyContext(harness, model, authMode, deps) that returns {} with no I/O unless harness === 'codex' && authMode === 'subscription' && codexModelMinimumVersion(model) is defined; otherwise it resolves the binary with resolveHarnessBinary('codex', configuredHarnessBinaryPath('codex') ? { executablePath } : undefined) and returns { codexCliVersion } or {} when the binary or version is unreadable. In src/lib/system-prerequisites.ts make the codex entry's install.linux/mac/win use CODEX_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND (text unchanged). Add the tests listed in PRD WI-1; inject deps, never exec a real binary in tests.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-3. In src/lib/harness-resolve.ts replace `const decision = canUseHarness(winner, input.model, authMode);` with `const policyContext = await resolveCodexPolicyContext(winner, input.model, authMode);` followed by `const decision = canUseHarness(winner, input.model, authMode, policyContext);`, importing resolveCodexPolicyContext from ./codex/policy-context.js. narrative.Action: Implement PRD WI-5. Create src/cli/commands/doctor-codex-models.ts modeled on doctor-prime-agent.ts (re-declare the local CheckResult interface to avoid the doctor.ts import cycle) exporting CodexModelsDoctorDeps and async checkCodexModelFloors(deps) that emits one 'Codex model floor' row per key of CODEX_MODEL_MINIMUM_VERSIONS with the exact severities and messages in PRD WI-5: [] when the codex binary is absent; warn 'version unknown'; ok for non-subscription auth; warn below floor with fix 'Upgrade: ' + CODEX_CLI_INSTALL_COMMAND; ok otherwise.
